candidates.sentence: I will work to end illegal immigration, and to secure our border in order to preserve our sovereignty and protect Americans.
I thank the men and women who enforce our border laws and will continue to support them.

My record shows I have fought to defund Planned Parenthood, ban late term abortion (when a child can feel pain), and make sure individuals in the healthcare system will never be forced to take an innocent life.
Congress must enact a structurally balanced budget, cut spending, dramatically reduce our national debt, reform our regulatory system, and cut taxes.
Congress must assure that we fund, begin, and complete the border wall.
I support President Trump's decision to authorize National Guard troops to secure the U.S. - Mexican border and applaud the brave men and women in Arizona who have answered the call.
